name: platformnex-abilities
description: Org-approved Claude Code Abilities, managed by PlatformNEX. Changes arrive as reviewed pull requests.

plugins.name: agent-monitor
plugins.description: A pane showing each agent's progress and context use, plus the RAM this session and the machine are using. Opt-in; runs ps and vm_stat every 3 seconds.

plugins.name: pnx-context
plugins.description: A sidebar pane showing which PlatformNEX component the repo you are in belongs to, in four views (a live deploy's steps, what needs you next, the open release, and each environment), plus the change plan Claude asks PlatformNEX for. Once set up it also keeps your Claude Code connected while Claude Code is open, so the development cycles you start use your own Claude Code. Read-only except one button that opens a draft release (never deploys). Opt-in; connect by signing in with your PlatformNEX account (needs pnx 0.1.21 or newer) or with a personal API key.

plugins.name: bencium-ux
plugins.description: Bencium UX and architecture skills: controlled, innovative and impact UX design, design audits, typography, agentic UX, AEO content, adaptive communication and architecture thinking lenses.

plugins.name: ccw-workflow
plugins.description: Claude Code Workflow (CCW): planning, execution, review, testing, issue and team-orchestration workflows with their agents and commands. Needs the ccw CLI (npm i -g claude-code-workflow); some skills also use the Gemini, Qwen or Codex CLIs.

plugins.name: commit-message
plugins.description: Writes a git commit message for the staged changes. Use when the user asks to commit, or asks for a commit message.

plugins.name: design-taste
plugins.description: Taste skills for frontend design: anti-generic landing pages, premium visual design, minimalist and brutalist UI, redesigns, image-to-code, brand kits and DESIGN.md libraries.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic’s frontend design skill: distinctive, production-grade interfaces that avoid generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: playwright-skill
plugins.description: General-purpose browser automation with Playwright: detects dev servers, writes test scripts to /tmp, fills forms, takes screenshots and checks responsive layouts.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Anthropic’s plugin development toolkit: skills for agents, commands, hooks, MCP integrations, plugin structure and settings, plus agents that create and validate plugins.

plugins.name: pnx-fast-dev
plugins.description: PlatformNEX fast development: keeps the pnx CLI installed and current (SessionStart, once a day, in the background) and teaches Claude to use pnx dev intercept, connect and env against a non-production environment, preview pull requests (pnx dev preview) reach its databases (pnx dev db), and set up and run all of a System's components (pnx dev setup, pnx dev run).

plugins.name: pnx-harness
plugins.description: PlatformNEX layer of the engineering harness: guard hooks that keep agents off the release path, secrets and guardrail files (PreToolUse on Bash and edits; formats Python after an edit), gate skills (idea brief, PRD, ADR, threat model, pull request, release readiness), a compliance reviewer, and a guide to reading release, alert and cost state through the platformnex MCP server.

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: Harness core: the skill router, shared checklists (definition of done, security, testing, performance, accessibility, observability), reviewer/security/test/performance agents and lifecycle commands (spec, plan, build, test, review, ship).

plugins.name: harness-define
plugins.description: Define phase: interview-me, idea-refine, spec-driven development, constraint-driven development and planning/task breakdown.

plugins.name: harness-build
plugins.description: Build phase: incremental implementation, context engineering, source-driven and doubt-driven development, frontend and API design, git workflow, code simplification.

plugins.name: harness-verify
plugins.description: Verify phase: test-driven development, browser testing, debugging, code review, security hardening and performance optimization.

plugins.name: harness-ship
plugins.description: Ship phase: CI/CD automation, shipping and launch, deprecation and migration, documentation and ADRs.

plugins.name: harness-operate
plugins.description: Operate phase: observability, incident response and postmortems, SLOs/alerts/runbooks, cost review and release verification with canary.
